title: launchSettings.json
description: How a .NET project is launched: profiles for the dotnet CLI, IIS Express and arbitrary executables.

iisSettings.description: Settings for the IIS and IIS Express hosts.

applicationUrl.description: The URL IIS Express binds to.

profiles.description: The launch profiles, keyed by name. The first 'Project' profile is the default.

commandName.description: What to launch. 'Project' runs the project's own output.

applicationUrl.description: Semicolon-separated URLs the app binds to. Sets ASPNETCORE_URLS. Pin this to keep the same port across runs.

commandLineArgs.description: Arguments passed to the app, as a single command line.

executablePath.description: The program to run, for a commandName of 'Executable'. Relative paths are resolved against the project directory.

workingDirectory.description: Working directory for the launched process. Defaults to the output directory.

launchBrowser.description: Open a browser once the app is listening.

launchUrl.description: Where to point that browser: a path under applicationUrl, or an absolute URL.

environmentVariables.description: Environment variables set for the launched process.

hotReloadEnabled.description: Whether to start the app so edits can be applied without a restart.

targetProject.description: The consuming project, for a 'DebugRoslynComponent' profile.

inspectUri.description: Blazor WebAssembly debugging proxy URI template.
